fields.description:
{{sbc|Active:}} '''Zeri''' fires an electric pulse in the target direction that deals {{as|physical damage}} to the first enemy hit and {{tip|slows}} them for 2 seconds.

If the pulse hits [[terrain]], it transforms into a laser in a line that grants {{tip|sight}} of the area for {{fd|1.75}} seconds and fires after {{fd|0.85}} seconds, applying the same effects to enemies hit and {{tip|critical strike|critically striking}} for {{as|{{critical damage|{{#var:crit}}|{{#var:ie_mod_W}}}}|critical damage}} damage against {{tip|champions}} and {{tip|monsters}}.
